prerequisites: State changes of ideal gases, pure fluids and binary mixtures
Module 1277 Heat Transfer and Heat Storage

learning_outcomes.text: After participating in the module events, students are able to name modern, sustainable, and future-proof energy generation plants and concepts and can calculate their thermodynamic efficiency and CO2 emissions.
Students can distinguish different forms of energy, describe their use in Germany and worldwide, and analyze their importance in the energy system.
Students understand the properties and origin of various energy sources (fossil, renewable, nuclear) and can evaluate their advantages and disadvantages.
Students can explain the basics of combustion, set up energy balances, and assess the efficiency of combustion processes and their emissions.
Students understand the functioning of thermal power plants and can analyze and evaluate different concepts for electricity generation.
Students know the principles of combined heat and power (CHP) and combined heat, power, and cooling (CHPC) and can explain their application possibilities and energetic advantages.
Students are able to explain the structure of the German energy market and the functioning of the energy industry.
Students can describe the technical properties of hydrogen for energetic use and evaluate its role in the future energy system.
Students understand the thermochemical processes of electrolysis and can analyze their energetic and ecological effects.
Students can evaluate the fields of application of hydrogen in industry, households, commerce, transport, and electricity generation.
Students are able to analyze systems for storing and using hydrogen and evaluate the hydrogen economy regarding production, transport, import, and consumption.

syllabus_topics: General definitions, different energy forms and their use in Germany and worldwide
Properties and origin of various energy sources
Fundamentals of combustion and energetic balancing
Thermal power plants and concepts for electricity generation
Combined heat and power and combined heat, power, and cooling
Structure of the German energy market and the energy industry
Technical properties of hydrogen for energetic use
Fields of application of hydrogen in industry, households, commerce, transport, and electricity generation
Systems for storage and hydrogen economy (production, transport, import and consumption)
assessment_rules: To receive credit points, the module examination must be passed. The grading is according to SPO.
